end.summary: Distinguished observation, hypothesis, law and theory using warming and curd-setting examples.
end.parentNote: Asha practised sorting examples into observation, hypothesis, law and theory, and Tara explained that a law describes what happens while a theory explains why. Tara correctly identified salt water as having a higher boiling temperature, but the idea that theories turn into laws remained at the end of the lesson. At home, ask Tara to make two columns—“describes a pattern” and “explains a pattern”—and place one law and one theory in each.
